profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, founded in 2004. According to its website, Meta builds AI models and tools for developers, offering access to Muse Spark through Muse Code and Meta Model API. The company describes Muse as tuned for long-horizon coding workflows with fewer unnecessary turns and cleaner output, performing competitively with frontier models across several coding evals. Muse Image, available on Meta Model API, is priced at $0.01 per image and is described as a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing with anchored composition for consistent edits. The Model API supports search grounding, allowing models live access to the web through a single tool addition.

Meta's flagship open-weight LLM family is Llama, available at llama.com and often self-hosted by developers. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the year ending December 31, 2025, and trades under ticker META on public markets.

Meta faces three active lawsuits: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the District Court of W.D. Texas; Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the District Court of N.D. California; and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the U.S. District Court of N.D. California. The company has significant legal exposure in California, with 208 tracked cases in that jurisdiction. Multiple MCP servers integrate Meta's services, including Meta Ads automation tools, the ai.livingmeta AI-in-Research corpus of 12,400 papers, and Primeta for AI avatars with custom personas.
